name_reason: Name is fully compliant with the global naming convention: data_fd2_battle_ prefix (battle core table), summon_main_anim domain descriptor, 12slot is a meaningful domain dimension (the 12 sprite slots of the main summon animation, matches int[12] and the i<12 init loop, NOT a Ghidra address residue), color_idx_array reflects both content (per-slot color/row-offset index) and data type (array). No hex address suffix. Confirmed accurate against access pattern: init writes color_idx[i]=i (0..11), rotation writes color_rotation_counter % 12, reads index into the per-color y/v/sprite offset tables.
purpose: Per-slot current color/row-offset index (0..11) for the main 12-slot summon-spell animation; selects which per-color y/v/sprite offset each slot uses when blitting.
logic_summary: int[12] zero-bss runtime scratch owned solely by fd2_tick_summon_spell_main_animation_state (@0x26795). INIT (state_code 0) seeds color_idx[i] = i for i in 0..11 (WRITE @0x2681b). TICK frames (state_code 2/5/8) read color_idx[i] (READ @0x268c5/0x26911/0x26944) to pick spr_offsets[color]/y_offsets[color]/v_offsets[color] for the blit and to gate frame-0/frame-3 SFX. When a slot's frame counter hits 0xB and terminate_flag==0, the color is rotated: color_idx[i] = (++color_rotation_counter) % 12 (WRITE @0x269ae). Values always stay in 0..11. Access is dword-wide, 4-byte strided.
element_semantics: Element [i] = current per-color row-offset index for sprite slot i, in 0..11; indexes the three per-color offset tables (v_offset, sprite_offset, y_offset) and is set to the slot index at INIT then to color_rotation_counter % 12 on each frame-0xB color rotation.
